title: ClusterLM backend capability descriptor, contract v1 (ADR 0401)

tensor_formats.description: Quantization/tensor type names the backend can execute (GGUF type names). A model with a tensor type not listed here is rejected before provisioning.

family_match.description: Exact family id or a glob over the library's family field.

evidence.description: CI job / test names / HQ ids that justify the label.

unlisted_family_status.description: Status for a model whose family is not listed. 'Experimental' means: parses and a Host-only load is attempted on explicit user opt-in; it is never offered as distributable.

requires_runtime.description: e.g. 'cuda>=12.0'. Detected at runtime; absent => backend not offered (never advertised).

validated_max_workers.description: Largest Worker count that has an automated test (real or fixture) behind it. Profile validation rejects max_workers above this. Raising it needs evidence recorded in `evidence`.

validated_topologies.description: Human-readable shapes covered by tests, e.g. 'host-prefix → worker → worker → host-tail'.

cpu_gpu_hybrid.description: Weights/experts split across CPU RAM and GPU VRAM within one machine.

worker_roles.description: Stage roles a Worker may play. Prefix and tail are always Host (ExecutionDomain contract).

supports_rollback.description: How an aborted/partially accepted speculative window is undone (llama.cpp recurrent state without seq_rm falls back to recompute).

per_client_isolation.description: True when a session's state can be held and released independently of other sessions on the same domain.

serving.description: What the serving layer may rely on. Tool calling itself is a property of the model's chat template + parser, not of the backend; these are the backend-side prerequisites.

constrained_decoding.description: Grammar/JSON-schema constrained sampling available. If false, `response_format` json_schema requests are refused rather than emulated.

hardware_experiments.description: Ids in HARDWARE-QUALIFICATION.md that must pass to move the label to 'Supported and qualified'.
